author: hasl
body:
Hello all o/,

With the ever lasting conflict around the Manager rank, it's time to get the broad spread of opinions collected and presented to the admin team for them to make a final judgement on the future of the rank.

Please complete with honesty: https://blizzem.typeform.com/to/uqv6Qw

The more personal questions aren't required, so you can submit your feedback completely anonymously if you wish.

Thanks in advance,
- (Admins)

N.B: This is unofficial, but I have a seal of approval from an administrator.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
The community probably won't determine if it stays or not... that's more of a management decision for the higher-ups and how that rank can be repurposed. Rather than just taking a vote, maybe we can discuss on how we can repurpose the rank instead (considering it's staying for now?)

I'd say just put it to the department system I had, and give managers senior again with those roles they excel in to manage, or alternatively just give managers admin if you see them as primarily management in succession and in better light than seniors, enough to manage complaints on the seniors... so, that'd mean 2 new admins.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
1. It complicates policies more, tacking on to (from jahaj's words) a 20 page policy already.
2. It had a confusing role as to what it was defined to do, and it still can be ambiguous.
3. Any new staff division directly affects players. What do they go to? What is the system?
4. If the staff have a problem with it, then that makes it harder for them to work as a team.

Overall, it's not very organized.

replies.body:
There's no reason to create a rank for a job that can easily be administered by the Seniors or the Admins. Fucking "Staff Spotlight" is a job in the Managers' checklists.
The fact that we have low players isn't even a factor at this point, the Manager rank is so fucking unnecessary. Turning the staff team into a pile of unorganized shit indirectly affects the players, because the staff team is technically our foundation. I don't give two shits if a player has too many ranks. If you're going to make a rank, make it useful.

Side note: Translator rank sucks ass too.
